selection: Eight additional US Gulf landfalls in the existing price range; selected by event mechanism/geography, before reading outcomes. Includes weaker wind comparisons. Not an exhaustive or representative population.

events.title: Humberto landfall near High Island

evidence.locator: Tropical cyclone update; printed 0210 CDT; landfall around 0200 CDT
evidence.summary: Humberto landfall near High Island. Printed operational bulletin supplies timing; forecasts preceded landfall.

features.impact_basis: Exposure hypothesis: storm can constrain crude supply and refinery demand; direction not measured.

severity.limitation: Operational wind at the cited bulletin time, not flooding, outage size or economic severity. A later best-track estimate is not substituted.

events.uncertainty: Selected research sample, not all Gulf storms. Earlier forecasts and reports existed. First located supporting bulletin is not proof of first dissemination. No sourced outage magnitude, recovery duration or market attribution.
